slides.title: Where does the work happen?
slides.lead: The computer performs analysis and gesture inference in these labs.
points: MCU: QMI8658 acquisition, timestamps, drawing operations and touch events
USB: samples travel to the host; drawing commands travel back
Host Python: NumPy, FFT, TFLite and UI logic
slides.notes: Trace one sample all the way through the diagram. A small int8 model can fit an MCU; that does not mean this lab runs inference there.

slides.title: Choose the right data path
slides.lead: Replay changes the input source; it does not replace the physical display.
points: es3c28p: replay motion and physical screen
No board: Labs 9.1 and 9.2 replay fully; use this deck for display simulations
Bundled CSVs: synthetic motion with noise, not measured board recordings
